Public string storing the base URI prefix for token metadata, set by setBaseURI.
Public uint256 mint price in wei (0.03 ether) required from non-whitelisted minters and used in withdraw fund splitting.
Public uint256 cap (7000) used as the modulus of the pseudo-random candidate selection.
Public bool campaign pause flag toggled by owner and checked in createCollectible.
Payable address receiving the tip portion of withdrawn funds in withdraw().
Payable address receiving the base portion of withdrawn funds in withdraw().
Mapping(address=>bool) marking users exempt from the mint payment requirement.
Private mapping(uint256=>bool) tracking which candidate IDs have already been minted, used to avoid collisions.
Private mapping(uint256=>string) storing the random candidate value associated to each minted token id.
Public uint256 counting minted tokens and used as the next token id and as the revenue multiplier in withdraw().
EthJuanchos constructor initializing ERC721 name/symbol and setting tokenCounter to zero.
Payable nonReentrant mint entry point: enforces pause/payment checks, picks a random candidate, mints and records metadata.
OnlyOwner function toggling the paused campaign state.
OnlyOwner function adding an address to the whitelisted mapping.
OnlyOwner function removing an address from the whitelisted mapping.
OnlyOwner function updating the base extension string.
View override returning the concatenated base URI, candidate value and extension for a token id.
OnlyOwner function updating the base URI string.
OnlyOwner function minting a batch of reserved NFTs using the same random candidate logic.
Private view pseudo-random generator hashing block.difficulty, block.timestamp and a constant, modulo maxSupply.
OnlyOwner function updating the msig payable address.
OnlyOwner function updating the creators payable address.
OnlyOwner payable function splitting the contract balance between creators and msig using eth transfer calls.
Caller-supplied address used for whitelist lookup, mint recipient and ownership checks.
Miner-influenced block timestamp fed into the random() entropy hash.
Weak randomness: keccak256 over block.difficulty/block.timestamp and a public constant, predictable by miners.
External ETH transfer to the creators address inside withdraw().
External ETH transfer to the msig address inside withdraw().

String parameter of setBaseURI().

edges.reason: msg.sender is used in createCollectible for the whitelist lookup and as the mint recipient.
msg.sender becomes the receiver of the safe mint, so the external callback is directed to caller-controlled code.
createCollectible invokes _safeMint, which performs the external receiver callback.
createCollectible calls random() to pick the candidate value.
random() hashes block.timestamp into its entropy source, making the mint outcome miner-influenced.
random() feeds the predictable keccak256 entropy computation.
createCollectible reads the paused flag to gate minting.
createCollectible reads cost to validate the sent payment.
createCollectible reads whitelisted[msg.sender] to bypass the payment requirement.
createCollectible reads and writes metadatas to avoid candidate collisions.
createCollectible reads and increments tokenCounter as the new token id.
createCollectible writes tokenIdtoCandidate for the minted token.
reserve reads and increments tokenCounter while minting reserved tokens.
reserve calls random() for each reserved token.
reserve invokes _safeMint for every reserved token, triggering external callbacks.
withdraw executes the ETH transfer to the creators address.
withdraw executes the ETH transfer to the msig address.
The creators state address is the recipient of the external base-funds transfer.
The msig state address is the recipient of the external tip-funds transfer.
withdraw computes baseFunds from cost multiplied by tokenCounter with SafeMath.
withdraw uses tokenCounter as the revenue multiplier and divisor input.
pause writes the paused state under the onlyOwner restriction.
whitelistUser writes whitelisted[_user] under onlyOwner.
removeWhitelistUser writes whitelisted[_user] under onlyOwner.
setBaseExtension writes baseExtension under onlyOwner.
setBaseURI writes base under onlyOwner.
setMsig writes the msig payable address under onlyOwner.
setCreators writes the creators payable address under onlyOwner.
tokenURI reads tokenIdtoCandidate[tokenId] to build the metadata URI.
tokenURI reads base as the URI prefix.
tokenURI reads baseExtension as the URI suffix.
The constructor initializes tokenCounter to zero.
The receiver contract can re-enter createCollectible during the onERC721Received callback before mint bookkeeping completes.

normalization_plan.reason: The boolean parameter is only used to write the paused state inside pause().
The address parameter is only used to set whitelisted[_user] inside whitelistUser().
The address parameter is only used to clear whitelisted[_user] inside removeWhitelistUser().
The string parameter is only assigned to baseExtension inside setBaseExtension().
The tokenId parameter is only used to index tokenIdtoCandidate inside tokenURI().
The string parameter is only assigned to base inside setBaseURI().
The quantity parameter only bounds the mint loop inside reserve().
The address parameter is only cast and stored into msig inside setMsig().
The address parameter is only cast and stored into creators inside setCreators().
The candidate local is the output of the weak random computation and is only meaningful within that operation.
The new token id local is only used for minting and metadata bookkeeping inside createCollectible().
The base funds local is only computed and transferred within withdraw().
The tip funds local is only computed and transferred within withdraw().
